instructions: Which team should own this GitHub issue? Choose the team that owns the primary problem, not a symptom.

teams.platform: Builds, CI pipelines, deployments, infrastructure, Kubernetes, performance, latency, timeouts, caching, database, outage, server errors
teams.frontend: Web UI, CSS, layout, buttons, pages, browser rendering, accessibility, keyboard, screen reader, mobile view, dark mode
teams.security: Vulnerabilities, authentication, login, permissions, tokens, secrets, CVE, dependency advisories, XSS, injection, access control
teams.docs: Documentation, README, guides, typos, examples, tutorials, broken links, API reference wording

severity: Low: cosmetic, typo, wording, minor polish, nice to have
Medium: bug with a workaround, slow, flaky, confusing, some users
High: broken feature, failing builds, no workaround, many users, blocked
Critical: outage, data loss, security breach, exploit, all users, production down
